# Frills

> Frills is a free web tool that shows your TikTok LIVE or Twitch chat as cute speech bubbles on your stream. Pick a look, copy one link and paste it into OBS, Streamlabs or another streaming app. No account, nothing to install.

## Start here
- [Quick start](https://frills.valwidgets.live/start/): answer six questions and get your links
- [Chat overlay editor](https://frills.valwidgets.live/editor/): pick a look and change every color, font and corner
- [Frills on TikTok LIVE](https://frills.valwidgets.live/guides/tiktok/): how TikTok chat reaches your overlay
- [How to add an overlay in OBS](https://frills.valwidgets.live/guides/obs/): add the link as a Browser source
- [Test it without going LIVE](https://frills.valwidgets.live/guides/test/): practice chat with the name frills_demo
- [Add an overlay to TikTok LIVE Studio](https://frills.valwidgets.live/guides/live-studio/): what we know, and what to do if it shows tiny
- [What size should the overlay be?](https://frills.valwidgets.live/guides/sizes/): 1080 by 1920 for a vertical LIVE
- [Song requests with Spotify](https://frills.valwidgets.live/guides/songs/): !sr in TikTok chat, and the optional Spotify player
- [Chat not showing?](https://frills.valwidgets.live/guides/not-showing/): the checks, in order

## Overlays
- [All the overlays](https://frills.valwidgets.live/overlays/)
- [Alerts](https://frills.valwidgets.live/alerts/): follows, gifts and shares as cards on your stream
- [Last gifts](https://frills.valwidgets.live/gifts/): the newest TikTok gifts as a list
- [Goal](https://frills.valwidgets.live/goal/): a bar for followers, gift diamonds or likes
- [Top likers](https://frills.valwidgets.live/likers/): a live ranking of who tapped the most likes
- [Song requests](https://frills.valwidgets.live/songs/): viewers ask for songs with !sr, with an optional Spotify player
- [Cute looks and pets](https://frills.valwidgets.live/looks/): cats, frogs, hamsters and bunnies on your chat
- [Cat chat overlay](https://frills.valwidgets.live/looks/neko-cafe/), [frog](https://frills.valwidgets.live/looks/frog-pond/), [hamster](https://frills.valwidgets.live/looks/hamster-burrow/) and [bunny](https://frills.valwidgets.live/looks/bunny-cloud/) packs
